comment: Independent invent.c witness for the unique-item impossible() reports: in debug mode a Priest wishes for the Book of the Dead twice. addinv_core1() finds u.uhave.book already set for the second copy and prints "already have the book?" with impossible()'s two follow-up lines. Dropping the first copy clears u.uhave.book, so dropping the second reaches freeinv_core()'s "don't have the book?" report.
